mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the condition occurs in > 60% of cases without negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both decline, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (t-test p>0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals central bank hawkishness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or the condition occurs in > 60% of cases without negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When job growth (PAYEMS) slows (MoM growth < 0.2%) and unemployment (UNRATE) rises (MoM > 0.1%), it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.1% (t-test p>0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
